duster.headline: New R238500 2022 Intens auto diesel is the standout full-criteria match; several overpriced diesels should be skipped.

shortlist.note: 2022 Intens auto diesel, R238500, 57k km, R19.2k under — ticks auto, diesel, 2020+.
2022 Zen diesel R209990, 72k km, R25.3k under; manual is only drawback.
Cheapest auto diesel: 2019 Dynamique R195000, 88.5k km, pre-2020, R6.2k under.

alerts.line: 2021 TechRoad R269990 flagged R37.5k overpriced — skip.

caddy.headline: Thin market: single 2020 Crew Bus at R279990 sits under both caps — verify carefully before committing.

shortlist.note: 2020 1.6 Crew Bus, R279990, 76k km, manual petrol; sole listing, verify service history.

alerts.line: Sole listing — no price benchmark; inspect thoroughly.

jimny.headline: Two 3-door Jimnys under R300k; cheapest is 2018 1.3 at R234890; no 5-door models listed.

shortlist.note: 2018 1.3 3-door, R234890, 86k km, manual — cheapest viable; Pinetown dealer.
2021 1.5 GLX AllGrip 3-door, R295995, 25k km — near cap, private seller.

seltos.headline: Strong bargain market: cheapest autos R210000 and R274990 both R31k+ under model price; manual EX R189900 standout.

shortlist.note: 2021 1.6 EX Auto, R210000, 100k km, R35.2k under — cheapest auto; km at cap.
2023 1.6 EX Auto, R274990, 44k km, R31.1k under — low-km newer alternative.
2021 1.6 EX manual, R189900, 93.8k km, R50.6k under — standout if manual accepted.

alerts.line: 2022 CRDi auto R289900 flagged R36.8k overpriced — skip.

creta.headline: New 2021 Premium manual is fairly priced; best autos are R249990 diesel (verify generation) and R279900 2023.

shortlist.note: 2023 1.5 Executive auto, R279900, 77.8k km, R20.2k under — clean gen2 pick.
2021 1.6D Executive auto diesel, R249990, 98k km, R16.1k under; verify gen1 vs gen2.
2021 1.5 Premium manual, R199990, 81k km, R38.7k under — bargain if manual accepted.

alerts.line: 2021 1.5D auto R299990 flagged R30.7k overpriced — skip.

hr-v.headline: Thin market: two old-gen autos; 2021 Comfort at R249,990/57k km is the value pick over the older, pricier Elegance.

shortlist.note: 2021 old-gen: 448L boot, Magic Seats; CVT, 57k km, R49k cheaper than Elegance.
2020 Elegance, 50k km; higher spec but R298,990 — R49k premium for older car hard to justify.

alerts.line: Elegance: R49k premium over newer Comfort — skip

corolla-cross.headline: Best value in weeks: 2021 XS at R249,990/36k km sits R28.9k under model; new Umhlanga XS overpriced.

shortlist.note: 2021 XS, 36k km, R249,990 — R28.9k under model; Toyota resale, 440L boot. Top pick.
2022 Xi, 66k km, R269,000, R9.9k under; base spec cloth/manual aircon — cheapest newer option.
2024 Xi, 70k km in one year — likely fleet; R279,990, R16.5k under; verify history.

alerts.line: New Umhlanga XS overpriced R6k; 77k km

mg-zs.headline: All-facelift stock, near-new and low-km; 2026 Comfort at R249,900/9.9k km leads, but resale remains unproven.

shortlist.note: 2026 Comfort, 9.9k km, R249,900, R13.5k under; facelift 443L boot; full MG warranty remains.
2025 Luxury, 23k km, R259,900 — R10k more buys higher spec; R6.1k under model.
2026 Comfort, 14.7k km, R249,950; near-identical to pick, R6.8k under — solid backup.

alerts.line: R269,900 Luxury lists no dealer — verify seller

haval-h6.headline: 2019 manual slashed R46k to R119,990 but high-km; 2022 2.0T Premium at R279,990/51k km is the smarter auto buy.

shortlist.note: 2022 2.0T Premium, 51k km, R279,990; cheapest auto, GWM/Haval franchise — good Duster trade-in candidate.
2022 2.0T Luxury, 53k km, R297,880 — top trim, low km; R8k over the Premium.
2022 2.0T Luxury, 66k km, R289,990; mid-pack, 14k km more than Autotique unit.

alerts.line: 2019 manual cut to R119,990; warranty/km nearly exhausted

peugeot-2008.headline: Stable market; 2024 Active at R239,950/30k km is the pick — verify wet-belt service history before committing.

shortlist.note: 2024 Active, 30k km, R239,950 — newest low-km value; gen2 434L boot, 6AT.
2022 Allure, 55k km, R229,990 — cheapest entry; higher spec, but check wet-belt history.
2025 Active, 32k km, R259,950 — R20k premium over 2024 for one newer year; thin justification.

alerts.line: All PureTech 1.2T — demand wet-belt service proof

proton-x70.headline: Buyer's market: seven X70s clustered at CMH Pinetown/Hillcrest yards; 2023 Standard at R209,899 is standout value — test DCT heat in traffic.

shortlist.note: Cheapest by R20k: 2023, 68,100 km, estUnder ~+R18k; CMH yard simplifies Duster trade-in; verify history.
2023 Executive AWD at 2022 money: R239,900, 67,000 km, estUnder ~+R8k; AWD suits Duster 4x4 swap.
Same R239,900 but 2022, 66,500 km, estUnder ~+R2k; backup only if 28049099 sells.

alerts.line: Overpriced: 2022, 81,365 km, R249,990 — worse than cheaper newer cars.

discovery.headline: Only MG ZS (443 L) clears the 430 L bar outright; add Omoda C5 conditionally for 2025+ X Series trims; all others fall short.

shortlist.note: 443 L clears bar; all 6 listings autos; R249 900-299 900 in budget; add outright.
Only 2025+ X Series qualifies (442 L); standard C5 is 378 L; add with year/trim filter.
